manual.strip_curtains.line2: {0}Strip Curtains are a bar with panels of {1}Tough Fabric{2} mounted to them and hung down.{3}
manual.strip_curtains.line3: Curtains can be used to block sight through doorways or conveyor openings without obstructing items or creatures.{0}
manual.strip_curtains.line4: When an item or creature passes through them, they will emit a redstone signal. Rightclick them with an Engineer's Screwdriver to enable strong signals.{0}
manual.strip_curtains.line5: They can be dyed in the same way leather armor can.
